description: This file defines the EventMonitor class, which tracks input events and state changes within an Android accessibility service related to input methods. It includes methods for handling input start, finish, and selection updates, and outputs debug messages.

classes.name: EventMonitor
classes.description: Monitors input method events and maintains input state, providing debug message callbacks.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Handles the start of input, updating state and editor info.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Handles the end of input, resetting state.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Updates selection and composition range information.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Generates and sends a debug message with current input state.

methods.name: cloneEditorInfo
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an EditorInfo object via parceling.
